title: Magecraft
description:
Annihilate an endless horde of monsters with the ultimate spell builder!

In this action roguelite game, harness the power of the ultimate spell crafting system to create weapons beyond your wildest dreams and wreak havoc against the monsters seeking your destruction. Utilize an arsenal of mods to customize a spell type and unleash it upon the monsters. With a fully modular spell builder, no run is quite like another, and the possibilities are limited only by your imagination (and your computer hardware).

- A powerful spellbuilder with a focus on modularity and freedom
- Forbidden Magics with tremendous power but potentially deadly consequences
- Equippable items to enhance the player's speed and power
- A progression system to become stronger every run
- Challenging bosses with unique mechanics to push your spell building to the limit
description_short: Annihilate hordes of mobs and challenging bosses with the ultimate Spell Building system. Infinitely customize your weapons and see how quickly you can break your computer! Abuse the open-ended nature of the spell creation system to destroy the game balance.
